requirements.requirement_text: The system must support SSO via Azure Active Directory.
All data must be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3).
The vendor must provide a disaster recovery plan with RTO < 4 hours.
Integration with Microsoft Teams for notifications would be advantageous.

results.excerpt: The platform enforces SSO via Azure AD using SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect, requiring all users to authenticate before accessing any resource.
All stored data is encrypted using AES-256 with keys managed in Azure Key Vault. All network traffic uses TLS 1.3 with HSTS enforcement.
